001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api;
002
003import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
006
007import java.util.Locale;
008
009public class CommonUtil {
010
011  private CommonUtil() {
012
013  }
014
015  public static boolean isEmptyComponent(@Nullable final Component component) {
016
017    if(component == null) {
018      return true;
019    }
020    if(component.equals(Component.empty())) {
021      return true;
022    }
023    return component.equals(Component.text(""));
024  }
025
026  public static String legacyYamlKeyToNamespacedKey(@NotNull final String key) {
027    final String normalized = key.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
028    final int index = normalized.indexOf('.');
029
030    if (index == -1) {
031      return normalized;
032    }
033
034    return normalized.substring(0, index) + ":" + normalized.substring(index + 1);
035  }
036}
